headline: 63 moons subsidiary raises FY27 guidance to ₹600 crore
summary: 63 moons technologies' subsidiary 63SATS Cybertech reported H1 billed revenue of ₹218.21 crore, 2.5x FY26. Order book stands at ₹400 crore with 55% conversion. Full-year guidance raised from ₹350 crore to ₹600 crore.

headline: Aeroflex board to meet Oct 14 on expansion
summary: Aeroflex Industries board meets October 14, 2026, to approve expansion plans and capacity enhancements. Trading window closed since September 28, 2026.
